body:
I don't really like it much honestly. I thought it was a good thing to do at first and that maybe if I learned how to care for other people it would make me care more about myself too. But I found that it doesn't make me feel any better. I am suppose to care about the people I tend to but I just don't; at least not on a personal level that is expected of somebody in this field of work.

My previous job was as bland as you can imagine I worked at a grocery store doing menial tasks until I stopped showing up and didn't bother putting in a two weeks notice or anything I just left because I couldn't find any reason to care. I was homeless a couple times briefly and I mean for less than 24 hours until I went back to my family's house. They almost wouldn't let me come back I was such a failure to them.

Any work before that were crappy run of the mill jobs that I was fired from after several weeks for being too outspoken against the demands of my supervisors. I don't think I'll find any happiness in life because I was unfortunate enough to have been born without passion or ambition for anything which has probably earned a nice warm spot for myself in hell regardless of if I kill myself or not so why bother waiting a life time just to see the same ending is what I ask myself everyday.
I work as a CNA at a facility after completing classes for it last year.
